segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cream absorbs without breaking them out, though a couple find it too heavy for the face and prefer applying only a thin layer or using it on the body instead.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or extremely dry skin, including several managing eczema or psoriasis, report the cream relieves flaking, cracking, and itching, often within days of regular use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe using more product on drier areas and less on oilier ones, saying it keeps their skin more balanced, though one found it too heavy on the oilier part of the face.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea, describe the fragrance-free formula as non-irritating, reporting no burning, stinging, or breakouts even with regular face and body use.
segments.normal: One reviewer with previously oily and dry patches reported their skin became fully balanced after consistent use, and another with normal-to-dry skin found it hydrating without feeling heavy.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s to 70s, including one following a dermatologist's recommendation for skin beginning to age, use the cream as a daily or retinol-adjacent routine staple and describe softer, more comfortable skin, though one claim of wrinkles disappearing overnight reads as exaggerated.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers in their 50s-70s, and one following dermatologist advice for skin in her 40s, use the cream in an anti-aging or retinol-buffering routine and describe smoother, more comfortable-looking skin over time; one reviewer's claim that wrinkles vanished within 24 hours reads as exaggerated rather than a typical result.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including those with very dry, flaky, or eczema- and psoriasis-affected skin, report fast, long-lasting relief from dryness and cracking, often noticing softer, more hydrated skin within days; a couple of reviewers with drier skin still felt they needed to reapply by evening.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea, redness-prone skin, or medication-irritated skin (including tretinoin-related irritation) report the cream calmed redness, in one case within 24 hours; no reviewer reported the cream itself causing new redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the ceramides with visibly repairing or strengthening the skin barrier, including after damage from tretinoin or harsh weather, describing less irritation and more resilient skin over time.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin mostly report the cream does not clog pores or cause new breakouts, and one reviewer using it alongside other products noted a visible improvement in mask-related acne; no reviewer described it triggering breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally say the cream absorbs without excess grease or clogged pores, but one with an oily face found it too heavy to use there and limited it to the body, while another with oily skin applies only a thin layer to the face.

extraits.texte: I’m sure it’s a great product however there was apparently an explosion on the way to my house. Update: After dropping off the explosion at the UPS store, I picked some up from Walgreens. It really DOES feel good and the moisture does stay on for a long time. I’m have acne prone skin, and it feels pretty good so far. It’s a little heavier than I’d like, but I haven’t found any light feeling moisturizers that actually do their job. Update #2: Ok so after a week or so worth’s of use...y’all. Apparently most moisturizers don’t work. I have acne prone combination skin and on other moisturizers, I would have oily and dry patches. Y’all! I have NORMAL SKIN NOW!!! Granted I am using other stuff as well, but I have not oily and not dry anymore!! AND my skin looks SO healthy now. I don’t think I could ever really say that before. Again, I’m using other stuff but wow. I am the world’s biggest skeptic when it comes to face stuff as having struggled most of my life with skin issues. Hopefully they’ll package a little better but the actual product has worked amazingly well in only about a week and a half. The only reason it’s not given more stars is because it came damaged and I had to get it from somewhere else. I didn’t want to risk another potential explosion.

extraits.titre: A Reliable Moisturizer with a Few Quirks
extraits.texte: When I first opened the jar of Moisturizing Cream, I was struck by its rich, velvety texture. It felt substantial, almost like a luxurious treat for my skin. I was expecting something lighter, but this cream has a certain heft to it that suggests it means business. Applying it for the first time, I was curious to see if it would live up to its promise of quick absorption without leaving a greasy residue. One thing I noticed right away was how smoothly it glided over my skin. The cream absorbed faster than I anticipated, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated. It's become a staple in my daily routine, especially for those pesky dry patches that seem to appear out of nowhere. However, I did find myself wishing it had a bit more staying power throughout the day. By evening, my skin felt like it could use another application.

extraits.titre: Dirty tub but does the trick! Suitable for sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: The tub’s quite dirty and there is no manufacturing date so I’m not sure how long it’s been sitting around for. However it is sealed. Quite like the product, have only used it for a day so I can’t vouch for its long-term effectiveness. I have very oily skin but have eczema and rosacea so it seems to be gentle enough for my skin, and it absorbs quite quickly! Doesn’t feel too heavy.

extraits.titre: Love love love - and you WILL TOO
extraits.texte: CeraVe moisturizer cream is a constant staple in my daily skin and all over body care! The absolute best option out there for managing dry skin, as well as providing a protective barrier for your skin to keep it moisturized! I was given this cream from my dermatologist when i asked for a referral on a great moisturizer cream for women beginning to age in their 40’s. She immediately suggested this and said the the “moisturizing cream” option, in a screw on/off lid, is the BEST OPTION ! I have found that to be very accurate after having had tried the CeraVe Lotion, CeraVe Face moisturizer, or the CeraVe body lotion. Apparently “CREAMS” & “LOTIONS” are very different in their ability to effectively moisturize. I will never use anything other than the “moisturizer cream” in a round, plastic jar, for ALL MY SKIN CARE NEEDS! I apply after shower to body. I apply morning and night on my face. It’s a very thick cream but I believe designed that way for its protective barrier it provides for skin. I don’t shower daily due to a bad skin condition on my right arm... This condition usually breaks diwn your skin and cause skin to break open into sores that are hard to manage. I can say, with complete satisfaction that since using this cream, I’ve had nothing but strong, moist, and in tact skin on my arm. My medical team are constantly in amazement of how well my arm holds up and looks. They always compliment whatever strategy I’m using saying it’s doing a fantastic job!! I agree!! I ALSO

CeraVe products have become a staple in my skin regime since early this year. I’m so happy I discovered the huge benefits CeraVe products offer~the 3 essential Ceramides while moisturizing & protecting the skin barrier. This Moisturizing Cream doesn’t disappoint. It’s a bit heavy but smooths out easily & my skin absorbs it right in. There is such an amazing soothing feel once it’s applied. I have fairly dry skin but oily face. I’ve put it on my face once but it was too heavy for my skin type. So I use it everywhere else. I feel whatever type of skin you have you would love this. The 19 ounce jar is filled full & it lasts quite awhile. The price is definitely worth the quality of this cream. I have this as a subscribe & save item so I save a little bit with the convenience of ordering when needed. I definitely recommend this. It’s a keeper for me! My pics reflect the ingredients & other information for you.

I love this cream! I have been using it for a while and the 19oz last forever. You only have to use a little of it to moisturize your skin. I have very sensitive skin but this cream has never caused any skin irritation. I use it in the morning and at night. I am 76 years old but no one believes my age. Most of my friends are in their late fifties or sixties. Hyaluronic acid is what gives you the moisture needed. The Ceramides help restore the skin barrier and help prevent wrinkles. I have had people tell me, "but you have no wrinkles" and I say it is because of my CeraVe. I will continue to use it as long as it remains on the market because it is my facelift in a container.

I have used this cream on my face and body for over a year. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin on my chest, back, and face. I cannot use any products with fragrance, or I will have a severe breakout that will take days to clear up. It takes me a few months to go through a whole tub, and I use this almost daily. I have tried many sensitive skin lotions and found them too thin, and I started feeling itchy and dry skin within an hour. That's part of the reason why I love that this is a cream that keeps me moisturized all day! This cream also does not leave any greasy residue or sticky feeling.
